what: Columns of equal height (number, photo, year, description) stand side by side. They chase the distance received from wheel or drag by 7.5% per frame at 60fps, and a column that leaves the screen wraps to the opposite side by the full row width so the strip loops endlessly. On release, it glides a further last velocity × 500. Pressing a column brings only that column to the center and expands it to the open width (probe width, or 70% of the screen, 90% on phones) over .75s expo.out, pushing the columns on its right by the added amount. While one is open, the wheel does not move the row. Esc, an outside press or the close button folds it back over .75s cubic-bezier(.5,0,0,1) keeping the center, and pressing ← or → while open folds it and then opens the neighboring column. While moving, the board gets is-fx-moving (used to turn hover off), on-screen columns get is-fx-inview, and the open column gets is-fx-open

options.lerp: Share followed per frame (60fps), default .075 — at 1 it is instant
options.momentum: Multiplied by release speed (px/ms) for extra slide distance, default 500 — at 0 it stops where released
options.out: Fold duration (sec), defaults to the same as dur
options.ease · out-ease: Expand/collapse curve of the form 0.19,1,0.22,1, default 0.19,1,0.22,1 · 0.5,0,0,1
options.ratio · phone-ratio · phone: Open width (screen ratio) when there is no probe — default .7 · phone .9, based on a 700px width viewed on a phone
options.[data-fx-part=track]: Panel holding the columns (the panel itself if none)
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Pillar (required) — width via css (need not be equal), height is the panel height
options.[data-fx-part=probe]: (if present) empty slot whose expanded width is set in css — in the original it is 8 columns of a 12-column grid (6 columns on phone)
options.[data-fx-part=close]: (If present) close button inside the pillar
options.fx:open · fx:close: Detail on the panel when unfolding and folding { index, item } is shown — thumbnails and body are built at that point. Sending fx:close to the panel without detail collapses it

note: This intercepts touches on the board (touch-action: none) — even when swiping vertically on a phone, the row flowing horizontally is this part’s job. That is fine for a single hero that fills the whole screen height, since the page has no scroll, but when placing it inside a page that continues below, keep the board height lower than the screen. The sum of column widths must exceed screen width + the widest column, or the wrap seam will show.
